summary: Updated production Supabase migration script adhering to the four specific architectural requirements: 1) canonical_id on master with UUID FKs on all child tables, 2) complete removal of geojson_blob storage column, 3) migration to geography(Geometry, 4326) for native antimeridian crossing safety, and 4) corrected spatial view query with dynamic ST_AsGeoJSON and status='active' filter.
